parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the page to return in a paged query. Default value: **1**, which indicates that the first page is returned.

parameters.name: DomainType
parameters.description:
The type of the domain name to query. Valid values:

- **root**: root domain name
- **sub**: subdomain name.

parameters.name: FuzzyDomain
parameters.description: The search keyword for the domain name to query. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of domain names to display on each page in a paged query. Default value: **10**, which indicates that 10 domain names are displayed on each page.

parameters.name: SourceIp
parameters.description: The IP address of the access source.
